description: Rewrite the batch-one n>=8192 factor workspace into 128-byte-coalesced tile-major CuTe operand order, guided by the hosted profile's 4-of-32-byte global-load sector utilization. Make TRSM panels write factor tiles directly in update layout and use swizzled TMA/cp.async staging to remove strided compact conversion plus transpose/upper-clear traffic, while preserving panel math, every smaller dispatch, caller-stream semantics, caches, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Fused batch-one large-matrix factor transpose/upper cleanup with post-TRSM FP32-to-FP16 panel packing in one 256-thread launch, emitting only lower factor tiles plus upper tiles dirtied by diagonal 256x256 CuTe clusters. Wrapped build and all 17 official validation cases plus the fresh-input guard passed. The wrapped full-grid benchmark emitted no result for 1554.114 seconds, exceeding the environment's 1200-second allowance, and was terminated; no metric was emitted.

Repaired the timed-out fused launch by retaining Cholesky-to-TRSM ordering while restoring the proven tiled factor-copy and row-major FP16 converter as two caller-ordered kernels behind one wrapper. Wrapped build, all 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed. Large batch-one n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4669.082/14574.360/52747.852 us; aggregate measured 875.519 us versus the 873.487 parent.

Skipped factor-copy zero stores for upper 32x32 tiles outside diagonal 256x256 CuTe clusters, because lower-only input seeding and triangular cluster scheduling leave those cached-output regions persistently zero; retained cleanup only where a dense diagonal cluster can dirty upper elements. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. n8192/n16384/n32768 improved from 4669.082/14574.360/52747.852 to 4659.383/14560.601/52685.191 us; unrelated-cell variance left aggregate noise-flat at 875.540 us versus 875.519.

Halved factor-copy CTA count with a rectangular 8192-CTA grid whose blocks process two candidate tile columns per factor row, retaining coalesced 32x32 transpose and only diagonal-cluster upper cleanup. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and the full grid passed. The paired per-CTA serialization measured 4666.424/14579.232/53043.599 us at n8192/n16384/n32768 and 876.982 us aggregate, versus 4659.383/14560.601/52685.191 and 875.540 for one tile per CTA.

Restored one factor tile per CTA and changed the large panel converter from two 16-byte vectors per thread at 32-byte inter-thread stride to one contiguous 16-byte vector per thread, making each warp load instruction fully sector-coalesced. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. Extra converter indexing/work items measured 4675.439/14587.305/52902.667 us at n8192/n16384/n32768 versus 4659.383/14560.601/52685.191 for two vectors/thread; broadly slower unrelated cells produced an 888.684 us aggregate.

Replaced the compact column-major 4096-square factor workspace with a row-major workspace, made cuBLAS consume those bytes as an upper column-major view with transpose, and replaced shared-memory factor layout conversion with direct coalesced lower-factor emission; restored the stronger two-vector panel converter. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and the full grid passed. Hidden row-major solver layout work raised n8192/n16384 to 4808.901/14909.536 us while n32768 measured 52675.008 us; aggregate was 878.501 us versus 875.540 for the column-major factor path.

Used hosted job f18687fd574443a09cebecb18abc90c7 on exact trial-2 commit 012b70c/index12 to target the 2.36 ms panel factor plus PyTorch's 125.79 us direct-copy (78% excessive sectors) and 98.14 us triu/tril (87% excessive sectors). Replaced torch.linalg panel factoring with a coalesced lower-tile copy into compact column-major storage and direct workspace-backed BF16x9 cusolverDnSpotrf, retaining TRSM, FP16 conversion, CuTe rank-k, and selective upper cleanup. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. n8192/n16384/n32768 improved from 4659.383/14560.601/52685.191 to 4427.366/14108.885/51808.446 us; unrelated mid-cell slowdown left aggregate at 876.784 us.

Rewrote batch-one large storage as physical upper/output-transpose: direct contiguous panel-to-factor and factor-to-output rows, right-side TRSM over physical upper panels, strided compact FP16 column-major operands, and a column-major CuTe output view. Wrapped build and standard validation passed, but the full grid rejected all large cells: n8192 output had lower-triangle residual 0.0227, while n16384/n32768 reconstruction residuals were 0.0601/0.0909. No metric was emitted.

Kept every 4096-wide panel factor in its own compact column-major workspace slice, removed factor transpose/cleanup from between TRSM/conversion and CuTe rank-k, and emitted all final factors with one 3D-grid coalesced stack-copy after the last update. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4425.273/14079.414/51756.617 us, improving the immediate direct-panel trial's 4427.366/14108.885/51808.446; aggregate improved from the 873.487 parent and 876.784 immediate trial to 867.782 us.

Generalized compact panel factor/copy/convert helpers and the deferred factor stack to runtime tile width, then halved batch-one large panels from 4096 to 2048, reducing factor/half workspace footprints and shifting diagonal work into more tensor-core rank-k stages. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. n8192/n16384/n32768 regressed from 4425.273/14079.414/51756.617 to 5003.637/14778.470/52764.643 us; aggregate rose from 867.782 to 888.264 us.

Restored 4096-wide panels on the runtime-generalized direct compact/deferred-stack path and allowed non-deterministic cuSOLVER scheduling for the hosted profile's 200-register, 12.42%-occupancy panel factor kernel. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4429.669/14084.845/51849.063 us versus deterministic 4425.273/14079.414/51756.617; slower unrelated cells produced 877.647 us aggregate versus the 867.782 selected run.

Restored deterministic 4096-wide direct panels and replaced the rectangular 16384-block panel-to-factor copy with an 8256-block lower-triangular grid using one mapped 32x32 tile per CTA. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. n32768 improved from 51756.617 to 51681.558 us, while n8192/n16384 regressed from 4425.273/14079.414 to 4433.639/14103.077; aggregate measured 877.021 us versus the selected 867.782 run.

Best measured commit f70ec936b541155256acecc7615fa7f28e596399 reached 867.781536 us versus 873.487 parent. It replaces torch.linalg panel factoring with coalesced lower-tile copies into compact column-major factors plus direct workspace-backed BF16x9 cusolverDnSpotrf, retains each 4096-wide factor in a per-stage stack, and emits all factors once after TRSM/FP16 conversion/CuTe rank-k. n8192/n16384/n32768 improved from the pre-brief 4659.383/14560.601/52685.191 line to 4425.273/14079.414/51756.617 us. Hosted job f18687fd574443a09cebecb18abc90c7 profiled exact 012b70c index12: panel getrf 2.36 ms, 200 registers/thread, 12.42% occupancy, 57.39% no-eligible; PyTorch direct-copy was 125.79 us with 78% excessive sectors and triu/tril 98.14 us with 87% excessive sectors. Canonical artifact is autocuda/profiles/2026-07-19-01-44-06-cholesky-resumed-local-unmerged/brief-62-trial-2-012b70c13c6496db2aaef9b006f0328de5a7c6a5.ncu-rep. One fused-grid trial timed out; physical-upper/CuTe-column-major storage failed large correctness; 2048 panels, nondeterministic solver mode, and compact triangular input-copy scheduling measured slower overall. Every succeeded trial passed wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells. The manager granted exactly one hosted request, so no second/final capture was launched. Keep the search moving by profiling f70ec93 on the next quota window to isolate direct Spotrf and custom copy costs, fusing the post-TRSM FP16 conversion into a library/device solve output path, correcting physical-upper epilogue/scheduler orientation, or specializing deferred factor-stack emission without nonlinear per-CTA mapping.
